2. **Alaska's Status**: Alaska was not one of the states during the Civil War. In fact, Alaska was not even part of the United States at the beginning of the Civil War. It was purchased from Russia in 1867, two years after the Civil War ended, through the Alaska Purchase.

Given these points, since Alaska was not part of the United States during the Civil War, it could not have been part of the Northern Army or any other military entity of the United States during that conflict.

Therefore, the answer to whether Alaska was part of the Northern Army during the Civil War is:

B) No
